answer: Whose mask is this, when its mirror shows ten faces at once? Each player tends one lantern whose flame grows epoch by epoch, a sequential vigil no fresh mask can inherit, and weight equals seasons squared. A raven audit each dawn mirrors every flame to its funding root, so ten faces behind one root count as one. Ten fresh lanterns weigh 10 against one ten-season flame weighing 100, yet the fleet still pays ten vigils. One honest player tends one flame and earns what its own seasons earned.
